description.value: An exploratory study compared pretreatment functional and structural MRI characteristics of cannabis-dependent participants with healthy comparison participants and examined associations with subsequent abstinence during behavioral treatment.

spans.text: In this study, we explored the relationship between pretreatment striatal function and brain structure and short-term abstinence in response to behavioral treatments for cannabis dependence.

value: individuals with cannabis dependence would: (i) exhibit greater brain activity within the VS during reward processing (i.e., reward anticipation and reward receipt) during MID task performance; and (ii) have lower gray matter (GM) volumes within the caudate and putamen.

spans.text: we hypothesized that, relative to non-substance-using HC participants, individuals with cannabis dependence would: (i) exhibit greater brain activity within the VS during reward processing (i.e., reward anticipation and reward receipt) during MID task performance; and (ii) have lower gray matter (GM) volumes within the caudate and putamen.
